argv: Inspect this Strata repository. Use grep and read. Where does shape_engine_fetch install the Inkling engine, and where does it obtain the update feed? Cite the exact files and function names. Keep the answer short.
text:
`shape_engine_fetch` is in `terminal/setup.py` (line 9498). It:

- installs the Inkling engine via `shape_engine.ensure(shape, source, ...)` (`terminal/strata_control/shape_engine.py`, line 349), which fetches from the signed feed and installs into `shapes_dir(components)/shape` = `components/<shape>/` — the per-user component folder from `engine_component.components_dir()` (`terminal/strata_control/engine_component.py`, line 179; `STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR` or `~/.local/share/strata/components` on Linux, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Strata\components` on Windows).
- obtains the update feed via `update_cmd._feed_source(argparse.Namespace(feed=<a.feed>), EC.components_dir())` (`terminal/strata_cli/update_cmd.py`, line 142): `--feed` if passed, else `STRATA_UPDATE_FEED` env var, else the remembered feed from `updater.State(root).data["feed"]["source"]` (only `https://` addresses count as remembered; otherwise `default_feed()`).

After fetch, `shape_engine.find(shape, full=False, title=title)` (`shape_engine.py` line 174) locates the installed engine (returns e.g. the exe path via `.exe`/folder).
